apps.name: Projectivy Icon Pack
apps.description: The Projectivy Icon Pack is designed specifically for Projectivy Launcher. It now includes over 800 icons.

apps.name: Android Tv Minimalist Icon Pack
apps.description: Minimalist Icon Pack's goal is to provide a clean "icon-first" look, but instead with a unifying background color similar to SicMundus86's work. The icon pack prioritizes non-text symbols, using wordmarks only when unavoidable.

apps.name: Core Builds Icon Pack
apps.description: Icons are original geometry drawn on a shared 512 grid — simple shapes, rounded ends, one accent colour per app — not traced vendor logos. Backgrounds are fully transparent, so the launcher's own card colour shows through. It now includes over 900 icons.

apps.name: Arcticons Day&Night
apps.description: With over 15000 icons, Arcticons is one of the largest free & open source icon-packs available, featuring consistent and elegant handcrafted icons. Built for phones (1:1 ratio), it's nonetheless compatible with Projectivy Launcher.
